note: Real-device testbed — LANDSCAPE (owner landscape directive, 2 Aug; U1 iOS additions, first-player pass). SAUDA is a landscape-only game (see R0 / DECISIONS), so every capture/measure/profile run drives these landscape profiles: the four real Android devices as the PHONE-1 portrait set ROTATED (width/height swapped) + a reduced-motion variant, PLUS the two iOS Safari devices the owner's sister and other real testers hold (iPhone 12 and iPhone SE, U1). Widths/heights are CSS px (the layout viewport, long edge horizontal); dpr is the real deviceScaleFactor; reducedMotion drives Playwright's reducedMotion + the app's prefers-reduced-motion. The optional `chrome` field is the browser chrome height (URL bar / tab strip) that eats usable HEIGHT on iOS Safari — the capture simulates it by shrinking the viewport, since Playwright renders no real chrome; `safeArea` is the notch/home-indicator inset, which in LANDSCAPE sits on the SIDES (left/right), fed to the app via window.__saudaInsets (dev-only). The TS wrapper (deviceProfiles.ts) and the Node capture scripts both read THIS file, so a profile is edited in one place. The tightest budget is now the SHORT edge (360px height): legacy-740x360 is the default single-still smoke subject.
